description: This file contains implementations of comparison and analysis functions for the ocuduvec module, including SIMD-optimized functions for finding maximum elements and counting elements exceeding a threshold, as well as a function for finding a character in a span.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Searches for a character value within a span of characters, utilizing SIMD instructions for acceleration.

methods.name: max_abs_element
methods.description: Finds the index and squared magnitude of the maximum absolute value element in a span of complex floats.

methods.name: max_element
methods.description: Finds the index and value of the maximum element in a span of floats.

methods.name: count_if_part_abs_greater_than
methods.description: Counts the number of complex float samples in a span where either real or imaginary parts exceed a threshold, using SIMD optimization.
